tool.name: nf-core whamg
tool.description: The wham suite consists of two programs, wham and whamg. wham, the original tool, is a very sensitive method with a high false discovery rate. The second program, whamg, is more accurate and better suited for general structural variant (SV) discovery.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ whamg \\ -x ${task.cpus} \\ -f ${bam} \\ -a ${fasta} \\ ${args} \\ | bgzip ${args2} --threads ${task.cpus} --stdout > ${prefix}.vcf.gz
tabix ${args3} ${prefix}.vcf.gz
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": whamg: \$(echo \$(whamg 2>&1 | grep Version | sed 's/^Version: v//; s/-.*\$//' )) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
The wham suite consists of two programs, wham and whamg. wham, the original tool, is a very sensitive method with a high false discovery rate. The second program, whamg, is more accurate and better suited for general structural variant (SV) discovery.
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: whamg Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/whamg ]]>
